titleText.en: MY RESULTS ARE A SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT ON THE STATE OF THE AAAAAAAAAAAART
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish and English texts are the exact title attributes from the Spanish archive and official xkcd. The Spanish raster has a twelve-A scream; OCR mistook the three opening exclamation marks for letters. The readable English heading on the tiny presentation slide is inventoried as non-Spanish text; the remaining miniature slide strokes are not determinately readable lexical units.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Conclusión has a written accent on the final ó.
A repeated vowel can spell out a sustained cry. The number of letters shows its length or intensity rather than changing its basic meaning.
In an academic setting, defensa can name the formal presentation and questioning in which a student defends a thesis.

example.en: Her defense will be on Friday.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: What expression introduces a final summary or conclusion?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: This transition signals that the speaker or writer is finishing an argument and stating its main result. It is common in formal speech and writing.

example.en: In conclusion, we need another plan.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you name the formal academic presentation in which a student defends a thesis?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Defensa names the act of defending the research, and de tesis identifies the academic work being defended. The expression can refer to the event or the process.

example.es: Preparó las diapositivas para la defensa de tesis.
example.en: She prepared the slides for the thesis defense.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: defensa de tesis · ataque de tesis
cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why does the thesis presentation turn into a sword attack?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The comic takes the defensive metaphor in “thesis defense” literally and answers it with a thesis offense.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: A thesis defense is normally an oral examination, not combat. Calling the sword charge an ataque de tesis creates the opposite of defensa de tesis and literalizes the English caption's defense/offense wordplay.

applications.explanationEn: Mejor comes before defensa to evaluate and rank it rather than merely classify it.
Defensa names the academic event, while de tesis identifies the work being defended.
Buen comes before ataque to evaluate it positively.
Bueno shortens to buen directly before the masculine singular noun ataque.
